  "file": "sql/sql_prepare.cc",
  "copyright_header": "/* Copyright (c) 2002, 2015, Oracle and/or its affiliates.\n   Copyright (c) 2008, 2022, MariaDB\n\n   This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify\n   it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by\n   the Free Software Foundation; version 2 of the License.\n\n   This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,\n   but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of\n   MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the\n   GNU General Public License for more details.\n\n   You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License\n   along with this program; if not, write to the Free Software\n   Foundation, Inc., 51 Franklin St, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA  02110-1335  USA */\n\n/**\n  @file\n\nThis file contains the implementation of prepared statements.\n\nWhen one prepares a statement:\n\n  - Server gets the query from client with command 'COM_STMT_PREPARE';\n    in the following format:\n    [COM_STMT_PREPARE:1] [query]\n  - Parse the query and recognize any parameter markers '?' and\n    store its information list in lex->param_list\n  - Allocate a new statement for this prepare; and keep this in\n    'thd->stmt_map'.\n  - Without executing the query, return back to client the total\n    number of parameters along with result-set metadata information\n    (if any) in the following format:\n    @verbatim\n    [STMT_ID:4]\n    [Column_count:2]\n    [Param_count:2]\n    [Params meta info (stubs only for now)]  (if Param_count > 0)\n    [Columns meta info] (if Column_count > 0)\n    @endverbatim\n\n  During prepare the tables used in a statement are opened, but no\n  locks are acquired.  Table opening will block any DDL during the\n  operation, and we do not need any locks as we neither read nor\n  modify any data during prepare.  Tables are closed after prepare\n  finishes.\n\nWhen one executes a statement:\n\n  - Server gets the command 'COM_STMT_EXECUTE' to execute the\n    previously prepared query. If there are any parameter markers, then the\n    client will send the data in the following format:\n    @verbatim\n    [COM_STMT_EXECUTE:1]\n    [STMT_ID:4]\n    [NULL_BITS:(param_count+7)/8)]\n    [TYPES_SUPPLIED_BY_CLIENT(0/1):1]\n    [[length]data]\n    [[length]data] .. [[length]data].\n    @endverbatim\n    (Note: Except for string/binary types; all other types will not be\n    supplied with length field)\n  - If it is a first execute or types of parameters were altered by client,\n    then setup the conversion routines.\n  - Assign parameter items from the supplied data.\n  - Execute the query without re-parsing and send back the results\n    to client\n\n  During execution of prepared statement tables are opened and locked\n  the same way they would for normal (non-prepared) statement\n  execution.  Tables are unlocked and closed after the execution.\n\nWhen one supplies long data for a placeholder:\n\n  - Server gets the long data in pieces with command type\n    'COM_STMT_SEND_LONG_DATA'.\n  - The packet received will have the format as:\n    [COM_STMT_SEND_LONG_DATA:1][STMT_ID:4][parameter_number:2][data]\n  - data from the packet is appended to the long data value buffer for this\n    placeholder.\n  - It's up to the client to stop supplying data chunks at any point. The\n    server doesn't care; also, the server doesn't notify the client whether\n    it got the data or not; if there is any error, then it will be returned\n    at statement execute.\n*/",
  "before": {
    "emb_insert_params": "static bool emb_insert_params(Prepared_statement *stmt, String *expanded_query)\n{\n  THD *thd= stmt->thd;\n  Item_param **it= stmt->param_array;\n  Item_param **end= it + stmt->param_count;\n  MYSQL_BIND *client_param= stmt->thd->client_params;\n\n  DBUG_ENTER(\"emb_insert_params\");\n\n  for (; it < end; ++it, ++client_param)\n  {\n    Item_param *param= *it;\n    param->setup_conversion(thd, client_param->buffer_type);\n    if (!param->has_long_data_value())\n    {\n      if (*client_param->is_null)\n        param->set_null();\n      else\n      {\n        uchar *buff= (uchar*) client_param->buffer;\n        param->unsigned_flag= client_param->is_unsigned;\n        param->set_param_func(&buff,\n                              client_param->length ?\n                              *client_param->length :\n                              client_param->buffer_length);\n        if (param->has_no_value())\n          DBUG_RETURN(1);\n      }\n      param->sync_clones();\n    }\n    if (param->convert_str_value(thd))\n      DBUG_RETURN(1);                           /* out of memory */\n  }\n  DBUG_RETURN(0);\n}",
    "emb_insert_params_with_log": "static bool emb_insert_params_with_log(Prepared_statement *stmt, String *query)\n{\n  THD *thd= stmt->thd;\n  Item_param **it= stmt->param_array;\n  Item_param **end= it + stmt->param_count;\n  MYSQL_BIND *client_param= thd->client_params;\n  Copy_query_with_rewrite acc(thd, stmt->query(), stmt->query_length(), query);\n  DBUG_ENTER(\"emb_insert_params_with_log\");\n\n  for (; it < end; ++it, ++client_param)\n  {\n    Item_param *param= *it;\n    param->setup_conversion(thd, client_param->buffer_type);\n    if (!param->has_long_data_value())\n    {\n      if (*client_param->is_null)\n        param->set_null();\n      else\n      {\n        uchar *buff= (uchar*)client_param->buffer;\n        param->unsigned_flag= client_param->is_unsigned;\n        param->set_param_func(&buff,\n                              client_param->length ?\n                              *client_param->length :\n                              client_param->buffer_length);\n        if (param->has_no_value())\n          DBUG_RETURN(1);\n      }\n    }\n    if (acc.append(param))\n      DBUG_RETURN(1);\n\n    if (param->convert_str_value(thd))\n      DBUG_RETURN(1);                           /* out of memory */\n    param->sync_clones();\n  }\n  if (acc.finalize())\n    DBUG_RETURN(1);\n\n  DBUG_RETURN(0);\n}"
  },
  "after": {
    "emb_insert_params": "static bool emb_insert_params(Prepared_statement *stmt, String *expanded_query)\n{\n  THD *thd= stmt->thd;\n  Item_param **it= stmt->param_array;\n  Item_param **end= it + stmt->param_count;\n  MYSQL_BIND *client_param= stmt->thd->client_params;\n\n  DBUG_ENTER(\"emb_insert_params\");\n\n  for (; it < end; ++it, ++client_param)\n  {\n    Item_param *param= *it;\n#ifdef __wasi__\n    /* Type attributes belong to the descriptor, including NULL values.\n       Match set_conversion_functions before selecting the type handler. */\n    param->unsigned_flag= client_param->is_unsigned;\n#endif\n    param->setup_conversion(thd, client_param->buffer_type);\n    if (!param->has_long_data_value())\n    {\n      if (*client_param->is_null)\n        param->set_null();\n      else\n      {\n        uchar *buff= (uchar*) client_param->buffer;\n        param->unsigned_flag= client_param->is_unsigned;\n        param->set_param_func(&buff,\n                              client_param->length ?\n                              *client_param->length :\n                              client_param->buffer_length);\n        if (param->has_no_value())\n          DBUG_RETURN(1);\n      }\n      param->sync_clones();\n    }\n    if (param->convert_str_value(thd))\n      DBUG_RETURN(1);                           /* out of memory */\n  }\n  DBUG_RETURN(0);\n}",
